items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know all of them, you know, because Simon used to play them. I did the best I could with the clarinet work.

ctx.x: But did the band play hits of the

Oh, no, no, of course not, no. Like the band played about -- I don't know just how many. Maybe 15 Jellyroll Morton tunes, you know. But as I remember he had an audience even then because they'd come up and request things that they had heard on records by Jellyroll, you know. And he didn't have Simon then. Simon didn't go on the trip. I think he went back home to Chicago. And of course I didn't know all of them, you know, because Simon used to play them. I did the best I could with the clarinet work. So that came…
Then you went to another dance school.
